_doc: Status rules for docs/tools/fx_coverage.py (smoke & fire update, docs/proposals/smokefire_2026-11-24/PLAN.md). Ordered; first match wins. match = regex on the asset id (tik:<path>, sprite:<shader>, weaponsmoke:<shader>, vss:<type>, disc:<converter>); optional family / detail = regex on those fields. status: upgraded (our new art or behaviour wins in game - verified by expect, a regex on the WINNING pak), excluded (left alone on purpose - reason required), todo (still the retail look; an HD upscale alone is todo). A rule that matches nothing fails the check. Map-level exclusions (Omaha m3l1a/m3l1b keeps retail-name effects; disc missions keep the converter's own) are enforced where effects are retargeted, not here.
